_comment: Web integration-suite baseline (item 1 slice s3d, owner decision 2026-09-10). Shrink-only allowlist of test FILES (under web/tests/integration/**) that fail in CI (github-hosted Ubuntu runner, postgres:16 + redis:7-alpine services, journal replay via `drizzle-kit migrate`) — never derived from a local run. The earlier figures in this comment ('in CI 26/44 fail') are WITHDRAWN: they came from a ci.yml run whose integration step was crashing at the repo root with no DATABASE_URL/REDIS_URL, so it never executed a single test, and continue-on-error reported that crash as success (fixed by PR #489, d8ad025d). The numbers below are the first real measurement: 232 suites, 467 tests, 96 failing tests across 25 files. A file's presence here does NOT mean it is expected to fail forever — the release cut (owner decision 2026-09-10) requires this list EMPTY. NEVER add a new entry to grandfather a newly-broken file — fix it instead; if it is a genuinely pre-existing failure being captured for the first time, add it only with the CI run URL that proved it failing. Regenerate ONLY when REMOVING entries: `node scripts/check-web-integration-baseline.mjs --report=<vitest-json-report> --update` against a report showing the removed file(s) no longer failing, and commit the shrink. This gate runs ONLY inside .github/workflows/ci.yml, which is workflow_dispatch-only (billing reasons) — it does NOT run automatically on a PR and does NOT block a merge by itself; enforcement before a web-touching merge is procedural (contract clause 8: dispatch ci.yml on the branch and wait for success). Do not read a green PR as proof this gate ran.
